blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: И к тому же, любовь зла — ___ (полюбить) и козла…»
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Должно быть, слишком еще молода и романтична, если способна ___ (влюбить / влюбиться) с двух-трех взглядов…
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Если она писала, то, стало быть, уж в беседке ___ (стоять / лежать / сидеть / висеть)…»
exercises.why: «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68.

exercises.q: Если она писала, то, стало быть, уж в ___ (беседка) сидит…»
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Какой надо быть, прости господи, вертихвосткой, чтобы ___ (написать / писать) такое письмо незнакомому, да еще женатому мужчине!
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Павел Иванович повертел перед глазами письмо, еще раз ___ (прочесть / читать) и плюнул.
exercises.why: Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect;…

exercises.q: ___ (доказать / доказывать), что ты умный, гуманный и образованный человек!
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case». From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много,…

exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: Жена поглядела на ___ (сердитое лицо) мужа и прыснула…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: В это время вдруг в беседку заглянуло женское лицо с ___ (вздёрнутый носик)…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Имя свое подписывать ___ (считать) лишним, но не пугайтесь анонима.

exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.
